document.lead: You should spend about 20 minutes on this task.

chart.alt: Process diagram in eight stages on a tea plantation. 1: the top leaves and bud are picked by hand; 2: the leaves are withered on racks for 12–18 hours; 3: rolled by machine; 4: oxidised for 1–3 hours, when they turn brown; 5: dried in hot air at 120°C; 6: sorted by size; 7: tasted and graded; 8: packed — large leaves are sold as loose tea and small pieces are used in tea bags.
